messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — Zenith quoted 6-8w for the APAC H100 top-up after the last PO. We also have 12 DOA from the inbound batch (PO# Z-1847). Vendor says they can do partial air replacements but want to consolidate AWBs and bill a surcharge. Can we agree a split-air + sea handoff and negotiate credit for DOAs? Need customs HS code confirmation and whether we can avoid brokerage surcharge.
Sam Patel: pinging Zenith contact and pulling serial list now. Maria, do we want immediate air for the highest-priority nodes (apac-edge-1/2) or hold until replacement batch?
Kyle Rodriguez: i'd prioritize 4 units air to apac-edge-1 and the rest sea. air cost ~= $750/unit expedite + $1200 AWB consolidation fee (vendor estimate). If finance ok with one-off, will reduce outage risk.
Alina Wu: can we get vendor to absorb DOA credit? 12 DOA at list price is material. I need their RMAs + photos and depot inspection note to push for credit. Also confirm HSN/HS code for customs — that affects duties.
zenith-ops: @MariaChen hi — can confirm partial air. For the DOA we need serials + photos + RMA form. We can consolidate AWBs but consolidation adds handling time ~24h and a consolidation fee; we can waive 50% of the expedite surcharge if Redwood covers brokerage and customs clearance fees. HS code we ship under: 8542.31 (subject to local classification).
Maria Chen: copy. Sam, put serials into the RMA form and upload. Kyle, please draft the split-air manifest: 4 air, 8 sea. Alina, estimate the incremental cost if we accept vendor's 50% waiver vs pushing for full credit.
Sam Patel: uploading serials now -> RMA ticket id: ZEN-RMA-2026-314. Attached photos + depot acceptance notes.
ops-bot: RMA created by Sam Patel: ZEN-RMA-2026-314 (status: awaiting vendor inspection). Link: https://zenith.example.com/rma/ZEN-RMA-2026-314
Kyle Rodriguez: rough math: air expedite (4 * 750) = $3k, consolidation handling = $1.2k, brokerage estimate = $900 -> vendor 50% waiver reduces our surcharge by $1.5k. If vendor gives full credit for DOA (12 * unit_cost), that's a different story.
zenith-ops: reviewing RMA package. We can confirm inspection outcome in 12-18h. On credit: vendor terms require depot inspection to validate DOA; if validated we issue replacement credit against next invoice or return authorization. We prefer to offset vs new shipments rather than cash refunds.
Alina Wu: ok — proceed with depot inspection validation. For bookkeeping we need a provisional accrual entry if we expect credit; I'll set a hold on the next invoice cycle until confirmation. Please mark which serials go to the spare pool vs replacements into production.
Maria Chen: Decision: go ahead with split shipment. Air 4 units -> apac-edge-1 (critical), 8 units sea to staging in FRA-APAC hub. Do NOT deploy sea units until RMA completes. Vendor to waive 50% surcharge per their note if we handle brokerage. Procurement to negotiate full DOA credit during inspection window. Next update in 24h. :thumbsup:
Sam Patel: noted — dispatching AWB for 4 units within 8h once vendor confirms pickup. I'll also request vendor to flag shipments with expedited customs clearance on manifest.
Kyle Rodriguez: prepping manifest + provisional PO change order (attach to PO Z-1847). I'll send to zenith-ops and ops for signature.
zenith-ops: pickup ETA for air leg: 2026-03-22 03:00 UTC if RMA accepted. We'll queue inspection and provide disposition. We'll send consolidated AWB pdf to Sam once created.
Alina Wu: finance approved covering brokerage up to $1k for this event; any overage needs pre-approval. If vendor issues credit we apply to account. Please cc finance on vendor credit correspondence.
Maria Chen: action items recap: Sam -> upload serials + confirm AWB, Kyle -> manifest + PO change, Alina -> finance hold/approval, zenith-ops -> complete inspection & provide RMA disposition. Update back here in 24h or sooner if inspection done.
Sam Patel: uploaded AWB draft + serial mapping:
```
Air: apac-edge-1 -> serials: H100-AP-9012, H100-AP-9013, H100-AP-9014, H100-AP-9015
Sea: FRA-hub staging -> serials: H100-AP-9016..H100-AP-9023
```
Sam Patel: tagging ops contact on customs clearance and attaching commercial invoice with HS 8542.31.
ops-bot: manifest checksum ok. Tracking numbers will be posted when AWB is issued.
zenith-ops: received AWB draft. We'll confirm pickup window and upload AWB pdf after we schedule consolidation. Expect next message within 12-18h.
Maria Chen: thanks team. If vendor pushes additional fees beyond discussed, escalate to me and Alina immediately.
Kyle Rodriguez: noted. Saving thread for audit.
Alina Wu: also adding note to PO change: attach RMA id ZEN-RMA-2026-314 and condition for credit.
Maria Chen: closing loop for now. :white_check_mark:
